top_signals.title: Stocks Steady as Bond Yields Retreat; Yen Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks were steady as oil prices stabilized and bond yields retreated from multi-decade highs. The yen jumped more than 1% against the dollar as investors focused on factors that could bolster the currency, while remaining wary of intervention risk.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Putin floats 'chance' at peace with Ukraine as NATO chief warns Russia is becoming 'increasingly reckless'
top_signals.summary: Putin said peace with Ukraine remains possible while calling Kyiv’s warning on Russian airspace “state terrorism,” as NATO flags fresh risks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: PMQs cannot change Burnham’s political reality
top_signals.summary: Clipped up for social media, the session can shape perceptions. But it is events outside the chamber and previous pledges that ultimately will constrain the PM
